about.text: A conference that brings together perspectives from technology, ethics, and theology to discuss

paragraphs: There are rare moments in history when technological progress changes the way we understand ourselves.
In the age of artificial intelligence, fundamental questions about {{Imago Dei}} enter a new phase — one in which humanity attempts to create intelligence in its own image.
We explore how the rapid advance of AI challenges us to rethink what it means to be human, as well as the moral responsibility we carry at this historic inflection point.

items.title: Awareness
items.description: Highlighting AI's significant impact on society, economy, culture, and theology.

items.title: Interdisciplinary Dialogue
items.description: Creating a space where specialists from technology, ethics, theology, and business can collaborate.

items.title: Education
items.description: Providing new perspectives, tools, and vocabulary about AI for religious, academic, and civic communities.

items.title: Anticipation & Preparation
items.description: Exploring possible scenarios (positive and negative) for humanity.

items.title: Ethical Framework
items.description: Identifying shared values to guide the development and use of AI.
